01 — How we train

TRAIN HARD.
STAY LOYAL.

A gym for people who show up. Whatever your starting point, there is a way to train here — and people around you who want you to keep going.

01

02 — The Legenz way

NOT JUST
A GYM.
A LEGENZ.

Since 2007, Legenz Gym has been Ōpōtiki’s place to train. It is locally owned and run, built by the community it serves — and the values on the wall are the values in the room.

01

Strength

Strong bodies, strong minds. Every session is a step toward a stronger you.

02

Loyalty

Show up for yourself — and for the people training beside you. That is what a gym family does.

03

Discipline

Turn up, put the work in, repeat. Small efforts, done often, change everything.
